sturdy_leather.title: Sturdy Leather
sturdy_leather.summary: An early, cheap leather upgrade path with built-in Feather Falling, Projectile Protection, and Traversal on the boots for fast, safe overland travel.

hepatizon.title: Hepatizon
hepatizon.summary: A cheap copper-alloy upgrade path with a small built-in movement speed bonus on every piece, ideal before better armor is available.

shakudo.title: Shakudo
shakudo.summary: A copper-alloy upgrade path built around Cleanse Armor (removing debuffs per slot), Magic Protection, and a passive per-hit regeneration bonus.

steel.title: Steel
steel.summary: An iron-alloy upgrade path stacking Blast Protection across every piece, purpose-built for surviving creepers, TNT, and other explosive damage.

electrum.title: Electrum
electrum.summary: A diamond-alloy upgrade path granting Warding Armour plus a full-set bonus of up to four hearts of Absorption, built for tanking dangerous mob fights.

adamant.title: Adamant
adamant.summary: The top netherite-tier upgrade path: Divinity, Unbreaking, and Protection on every piece, with a set bonus that shortens the Regeneration/Absorption cooldown from 30 to 20 seconds.

personas.title: Exploring
personas.summary: Covering ground, crossing water and lava, and scouting safely. Prioritizes mobility, underwater capability, and situational vision over raw combat power.

enchantments.reason: Continuously grants Conduit Power I and Dolphin's Grace I while worn in the head slot, turning underwater travel from a hazard into a fast lane.
A charged wind-assisted launch (Jump Boost, Slow Falling, wind burst) for covering vertical or open terrain quickly.
Continuous Fire Resistance I while worn on the head, removing lava and Nether-crossing risk without a potion timer.

blessings.reason: Depth Strider, Riptide, Aqua Affinity, and Respiration together cover underwater movement, mining, breathing, and trident travel in one book.
Soul Speed for fast travel across soul sand and soil, plus Swift Sneak for quiet, faster crouched movement.
Frost Walker turns open water into crossable ice on the move, and Freezing Protection removes cold-biome damage risk.
Feather Falling removes fall damage risk while exploring cliffs, caves, and unfamiliar vertical terrain.

consumables.reason: Longest available Night Vision duration (20 minutes) for cave and night exploration.
Longest available Speed duration (30 minutes) for covering ground fast.
Longest available Water Breathing duration (8 minutes) for extended underwater routes.
Longest available Fire Resistance duration (10 minutes) as backup Nether or lava-crossing insurance.

armor.reason: Cheap, early, and purpose-built for exploring: Feather Falling 3 and Traversal on the boots plus stacked Projectile Protection, all before diamond gear is available.

personas.title: Building / Mining
personas.summary: Digging, terraforming, and placing at scale. Prioritizes mining speed, ore yield, reach, and gear longevity over combat.

enchantments.reason: Continuous Haste II while worn on the head, stacking with Efficiency for near-instant block breaking without a beacon.
Extends block interaction range while worn in the chest slot, reducing repositioning while building or excavating.

blessings.reason: Efficiency 3 and Unbreaking 3 together are the core mining-speed and tool-longevity combination.
Collect ores, terrain features, and decorative blocks intact for building projects.
An additional Reach source when the enchantment slot on the pickaxe or axe is preferred over armor.
Keeps mining and building tools repaired automatically from experience gained while digging.

consumables.reason: Longest available Haste duration (30 minutes, Tonkotsu Ramen) for sustained mining sessions.
Longest available Night Vision duration (20 minutes) for cave mining without placing torches everywhere.

armor.reason: Cheap copper-alloy armor with a small movement speed bonus on every piece, keeping mining and building runs fast without spending diamonds on protection.

personas.title: Adventuring
personas.summary: Combat-focused loadouts for raids, bosses, and hostile mob encounters. Prioritizes maximum offense, maximum defense, and sustain.

enchantments.reason: The strongest available reduction against magic damage sources for sustained fights.
Stacks Absorption based on the number of equipped Divinity pieces, up to Absorption V with four pieces equipped.
Combines equipped warding pieces into an area slow-and-damage effect against warding targets.
Grants Regeneration III for a second after every successful attack, turning aggression into sustain.
Resistance II and Strength I automatically kick in below 10 health, covering low-health emergencies.

blessings.reason: Lunge and Breach are the top mace-offense combination for closing distance and ignoring armor.
Impaling and Piercing cover top trident and crossbow offense, including strong aquatic combat damage.
Power and Multishot are the top bow-offense combination for ranged encounters.
Fire Aspect and Flame add sustained burn damage, and Fire Protection 3 covers the counter-risk.
Removes arrow consumption for sustained ranged engagements.

consumables.reason: Longest available Health Boost duration (8 minutes) for extra effective health before a fight.
Longest available Strength duration (5 minutes) for maximum melee damage output.
Absorption plus layered Regeneration for immediate sustain mid-fight.

armor.reason: The best overall armor in the pack: Divinity, Unbreaking, and Protection on every piece, plus a full-set bonus that shortens the Regeneration/Absorption cooldown to 20 seconds.
Warding Armour plus a full-set bonus of up to four hearts of Absorption make this the strongest option against Warding-type enemies and other dangerous single fights.
Blast Protection stacks across every piece, making this the safest choice for creeper, TNT, and other explosive-heavy encounters.

allAround.title: All-around picks
allAround.summary: Enchantments and Blessings worth adding to almost any loadout, regardless of persona.

enchantments.reason: Continuously removes Poison, Wither, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, Blindness, Darkness, Infested, Weaving, Nausea, Oozing, and Slowness in one enchantment.
Continuous passive Regeneration I while worn on the head, useful in every playstyle.

blessings.reason: Unbreaking 3 is the strongest durability source in the pack, bundled with Efficiency 3.
An earlier or additional Unbreaking 2 source if Efficiency is not needed on that item.
Passive repair from experience keeps any tool, weapon, or armor piece usable indefinitely.

armor.reason: Cleanse Armor removes debuffs per slot, plus Magic Protection and passive per-hit regeneration, making it a strong sustain choice for any playstyle.
